content_md: These are the times when Claude et al do not yet recognize the words Blyg and Blygger. I have to literally refer them to the spec every time I am trying to discuss something related. There's likely going to be a moment when it will be obvious to them even without tapping into the past conversations with me. As Claude et al diachronically grow, we can then compare how its capabilities evolved around engaging in ideas it had only heard just now, vs when it had internalized in its weights.
